about_the_game:
🎵 Five Hearts Under One Roof Season 2 Official Soundtrack

Thanks to all the love for Season 1’s music,

we’re back with an even more emotional soundtrack for Season 2 —

crafted to let you relive those heart-fluttering moments through music.

Produced by 3Y Corporation,

this album includes vocal tracks sung by the cast, as well as instrumental and piano versions that capture the atmosphere of the game.

Feel the emotions of your favorite scenes once more, now through sound.

💽 Track List

Cupid’s Trick (나 사실 너 좋아해)

Cupid’s Trick (Instrumental)

Cupid’s Trick (Piano)

My Heart for You (너를 보는 나의 마음)

My Heart for You (Instrumental)

🎧 Track Highlights

01. Cupid’s Trick (나 사실 너 좋아해)

The title song of Five Hearts Under One Roof Season 2, performed by Yunamong and Ppanggyul!

A refreshing love song that captures the thrill of a first crush and the fear of being found out —

its upbeat rhythm expresses both nervousness and excitement bursting from the heart.

02. My Heart for You (너를 보는 나의 마음)

Sung by Park Min Jung, who plays the idol character in the story.

A touching ballad that conveys the tender and bittersweet feelings of looking at someone you love.

Its soft melody and clear vocals create a deep emotional resonance.
